sources.snippet: MOSS-Image-heal A full finetune of MOSS-Image-Base with a healed residual stream: the largest stream value is 3,083 (base: 58,411; fp16 max: 65,504), the stream RMS is 7.5x lower, and every weight element is within 64x its tensor's RMS (base: 349 elements above). sources.snippet: MOSS-Image-FP16-fixed by KBlueLeaf provides FP16-compatible transformer weights for MOSS-Image-Base and MOSS-Image-SFT, using residual-stream rescaling to improve overflow headroom. Diffusers and ComfyUI formats are available; see the model card for loading instructions and adapter compatibility.
